summary: Pike National Forest lookout: first station 1912, present lookout 1951 per the NRHP nomination; not staffed in 2025 and not expected to be in 2026.

access.note: The trail to the lookout is public. The lookout was not staffed in 2025 and is not expected to be in 2026. The sources do not say whether the cab itself is open to visitors.

visit.trail_note: About 2.8 miles round trip with 143 stairs at the end. The road to the trailhead is closed to vehicles in winter until about April or May.

events.note: First lookout station established on the summit with a table holding a fire finder (NRHP). The register dates its 14 x 14 ft ground house to 1912.
Earlier tower, per the NRHP nomination; Wikipedia gives 1919 for the original tower
Helen Dowe, the first lookout in Colorado staffed by a female Forest Service employee, worked here until 1921
Present lookout and cabin built in 1951, replacing the 1919 tower
NRHP reference 03000518; NPGallery date published June 13, 2003
Renovated as a USFS and HistoriCorps partnership: wood repaired and replaced, new roof shingles, painted
Register note: stair treads about 70 years old and in poor shape
Per the chapter writer's understanding, GAOA-funded work with HistoriCorps improved the stairs and replaced the treads; not confirmed with the district
Closed up in fall 2024; not staffed in 2025 per the 2025 chapter report

corrections.proposed: 1912 first lookout station; present lookout and cabin built 1951, after a 1919 tower
corrections.why: The National Register nomination and Wikipedia both date the present lookout to 1951, and the nomination dates the tower before it to 1919. The register's 1912 date appears to refer to the first station.

resolved_conflicts.explanation: The register's 1912 date matches the first lookout station in the NRHP nomination. The nomination and Wikipedia date the present lookout and cabin to 1951, after a 1919 tower. Wikidata's 1951 matches the present structure.
Wikipedia gives both 1991 and June 13, 2003 for the NRHP listing. The NPGallery record for NRIS 03000518 is dated June 13, 2003.

notes_for_editor: Stair count: Wikipedia gives 143 stairs for the last stretch of the trail; the NRHP nomination counts 243 steps up the whole stairway. Staffing: the first documented staffing is Helen Dowe (1919-1921), so the story no longer says staffing began with the 1912 station. Built dates: the NRHP nomination (first station 1912, 1919 tower, 1951 present lookout) and Wikipedia agree; the register's 'constructed in 1912' for the cab conflicts, and the correction proposal relies on the nomination. Wikipedia gives the NRHP listing as both 1991 and June 13, 2003; the NPGallery record supports 2003. Elevation differs: register 9,702 ft (2,957 m; the record's 2957.2 m), Wikipedia 9,748 ft (2,971 m). Visitor numbers in the register differ (over 15,000 a year in one passage, about 40,000 a season in the 2019 note). The 2025 chapter report says the lookout was not staffed in 2025 and will not be in 2026; the staffing record is updated accordingly. Whether the cab is open to visitors is not established by these sources, so the access note stays cautious. The record's 2013 'frame-off restoration' and 2015 roof claims come from chapter PDFs I did not open; I cited the register's 2013 renovation instead, and the 2015 roof is not in the story. The 2022 stair work is the chapter writer's understanding, unconfirmed by the district.
